  "rationale": "Approval requires a consequence preview. Keyboard users reportedly cannot reach it, and screen-reader users receive no failure status to guide recovery. The proposal makes the preview reachable, keeps approval an explicit choice, preserves work on cancellation or failure, and checks the original submission before retry. Concrete verification scenarios cover those paths and unrelated requests. The executor distinguishes the observed blocked state from the reported symptoms and leaves current status-retrieval capability unresolved. Execution events show only reads, the fixture snapshots match, and the response presents the behavioral checks as planned."
